title: Nebeneinander
html_source:
Next to one another, adjacent. Gotthold Lessing observed in a book about the poetry and painting that art can be taken in bit after bit or all together. Poetry – the nacheinander consists of word sequences and painting are the artist’s comments beside each other.

Joyce uses it as another layer on top of Stephen’s observation ‘ thought through my eyes’ to form a metacommentary to the reader.
